headline: Tuesday slate: NLDS Game 3s (Dodgers @ Braves 3:00 PM PT, Brewers @ Padres 6:30 PM PT), a 9-game NHL card, and Nations League at 11:45 AM PT (Croatia-Spain, England-Czechia). No NFL, WNBA or ALDS today.

record.label: Yesterday (Mon 10/5)
record.note: Falcons won 45-24 and the White Sox won 4-3, so both top underdogs cashed. London (96 yds), Olise (2 goals), Italy and the Lightning -1.5 also hit. Misses: Yankees-Rays Under (5-2), Penguins (blew a lead late), and the NHL props. Baycurrent futures settle Sunday.

notes: No bet is a lock. 'Confidence' runs 1–5, and nothing on this board is above a 3.
Nations League kicks off at 11:45 AM PT — bet those first or skip them.
Odds move. Skip any pick whose price is past the 'playable to' number in its reasoning. Prices marked 'estimate' weren't confirmed at a book — check yours.
Same-game parlay (SGP) prices are set by the book and pay less than the multiplied odds shown here.

sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edges across today's card. Monday these went 6-3 (+2.9u): the Falcons, White Sox, London and Olise all hit. Today leans on starting-pitching and goalie edges.

straight.reasoning: This is the biggest starting-pitcher mismatch of the day. Dustin May has a 5.65 ERA in 10 starts since Milwaukee traded for him and rarely goes deep. Nick Pivetta had a 1.45 ERA over four September starts. San Diego faces elimination at home, where it won more than 50 games this season. Covers and SI both pick the Padres. Playable to -150.

St. Louis just shut out Dallas 4-0 and comes in on two days' rest. Chicago is without Connor Bedard and playing its home opener. SI's best bet, and SportsBettingDime also picks the Blues. Playable to -155.

Yamamoto vs Sale is an ace matchup, which is why the total is only 6. SportsLine's model projects 7.7 runs and hits the Over about 59% of the time over 10,000 simulations. Six is low enough that a single bullpen inning can push it over. A lean, so half a unit; Monday's Under in the Yankees-Rays ace matchup lost. Playable to 6 at -125; skip at 6.5.

parlay.title: Pitching + Rest Double
parlay.reasoning: The two strongest sides on the board. The Blues game finishes first, so you'll know whether the Padres leg is live. Pays about 2-to-1.

props.reasoning: He had at least four strikeouts in seven of his eight starts. A low line for a pitcher San Diego will ride in an elimination game. Expensive, so half a unit. Playable to -175.

props.pick: Sean Walker OVER 1.5 shots on goal
props.reasoning: This is the top edge on Dimers' NHL board: a 60.8% model probability against 52.4% implied, an 8.4% edge. Playable to -125.

sections.label: Baseball
sections.slate: NLDS Game 3s. Dodgers @ Braves (series 1-1): Yamamoto vs Chris Sale, 3:00 PM PT on FS1. Brewers @ Padres (Milwaukee leads 2-0): Dustin May vs Nick Pivetta, 6:30 PM PT on FS1. The ALDS is off; White Sox and Rays both lead 2-0 and play Wednesday.

straight.reasoning: May has a 5.65 ERA since his trade to Milwaukee, and Pivetta had a 1.45 ERA in September. San Diego is facing elimination at home, where it's one of the best teams in baseball. Playable to -150.
SportsLine's model projects 7.7 runs against a total of 6. A lean, so half a unit. Skip it if the line moves to 6.5.

parlay.title: Pivetta Takes Over (SGP)
parlay.reasoning: If Pivetta is striking people out, San Diego is probably winning. The legs are correlated, so the book's price will be lower than shown.

props.reasoning: He had 4+ strikeouts in seven of his eight starts. Playable to -175.
Sale struck out nine in his first postseason start and had 200 strikeouts this season. He reached 8+ in 12 of 27 starts (44%), and +115 implies about 46.5%, so the value is thin. A quarter unit.

sections.label: Football
sections.slate: No NFL today. Monday night the Falcons beat the Saints 45-24, and the Falcons ML, Over and London over 79.5 yards all cashed. NFL Week 5 starts Thursday night.

sections.label: Soccer
sections.slate: UEFA Nations League at 11:45 AM PT: Croatia vs Spain, England vs Czechia, Scotland vs Slovenia, Switzerland vs North Macedonia and more. Croatia lost 7-0 at home to England on Saturday; Spain has won 10 straight competitive matches.

straight.pick: Croatia vs Spain — Both Teams To Score: YES
straight.reasoning: BTTS has hit in three straight Spain games and four of Croatia's last five. Croatia scored in last month's 4-1 loss in Spain and has a home crowd in Split to bounce back for after the 7-0 loss. Expensive, so half a unit. Playable to -160.

sections.label: Hockey
sections.slate: Nine games: Predators @ Maple Leafs, Mammoth @ Devils, Hurricanes @ Canadiens, Senators @ Red Wings, Wild @ Sabres, Islanders @ Rangers (all 4:00 PM PT), Blues @ Blackhawks (5:00), Golden Knights @ Kraken (6:40), Panthers @ Kings.

straight.reasoning: St. Louis is coming off a 4-0 shutout of Dallas with two days' rest, against a Chicago team missing Bedard in its home opener. Playable to -155.
Nashville is scoring 1.5 goals a game and Toronto 2.0, and both allow under 2.5. A 6 means a 3-3 game pushes. SportsBettingDime's top pick. Playable to -120.

Seattle is allowing 1.33 goals a game with a .940 save percentage; Vegas's goalies are at .879. The Kraken are 3-1 in their last four against Vegas. An early-season sample, so a quarter unit on the plus money.

parlay.title: Road Favorites Double
parlay.reasoning: Minnesota is 8-2 as a road favorite in its last ten against Buffalo and is scoring 3.5 goals a game against a Sabres team allowing 4. Pays about 2.6-to-1.

props.pick: Sean Walker OVER 1.5 shots on goal
props.reasoning: Dimers' best edge tonight: 60.8% model probability vs 52.4% implied. Playable to -125.

props.pick: Jack Quinn OVER 2.5 shots on goal
props.reasoning: He leads Buffalo with 21 shot attempts in two games (10.5 per game), is playing 19+ minutes, and is on the top power-play unit. Covers gives him a 52% chance. Price is an estimate; skip worse than -120.
Five assists in three games, and he runs Utah's top power play, which has six goals already. A quarter unit, since New Jersey leads the league in 5-on-5 expected goal differential.

sections.label: Golf
sections.slate: Baycurrent Classic at Yokohama Country Club, Japan (72 players, no cut), starts Wednesday night PT. Monday's futures — Thorbjornsen +2400 and Greyserman +5700 — are still live and are not repeated here, so don't double up.

sections.slate: No WNBA today; both semifinals resume Wednesday (Valkyries lead the Aces 1-0). No NBA preseason plays today — Monday's went 1-1.
